comparison.python_side_defaults_note: SQLAlchemy create_all typically does not emit PostgreSQL DEFAULT for Python callables/literals. Application code supplies values on INSERT. Not treated as a missing-column failure.

mismatches.detail: Live database contains leftover Prisma tables `Item`, `Location`, `_prisma_migrations` that are not SQLAlchemy models and are unused by Flask WMS.
Model declares FK orders.processing_user_id → users.id. Live column exists as INTEGER (added by ensure_processing_columns) without REFERENCES.
Model is NOT NULL; live column is BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE and nullable because the additive ALTER omitted NOT NULL.
